instruction: Reply just to Alex on the migration timeline email: thanks, we'll confirm the cutover date by Friday.
final_text:
I replied to Alex Moreno in the "Migration timeline" thread. It went only to Alex:

> Hi Alex,
> Thanks, we'll confirm the cutover date by Friday.
> Best,
> Sam

Alex's email was also cc'd to Jordan Blake, Rachel Kim and Jordan Lee. As you asked, they weren't included on your reply, so they won't see it.

For reference, Alex proposed a dry run on Oct 8 and the cutover on Oct 15.
